properties.name: AC30
properties.notes: Land at Tankersley Lane. This brownfield site is part of a wider site (AC30) proposed for housing in the Local Plan Publication Draft 2016. It is not anticipated that the part of the site included on the brownfield register be developed in isolation from the wider site. The proposed policy also requires any development to be the subject to the production of a masterplan covering the entire site and also proposed employment site reference HOY1.
